propositions: The reconciler's committed `.bridge_state` cache constitutes 92% (approximately 950 MiB) of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch due to bookkeeping fields `baseline_advanced_at` and `last_get_pass` that are written but not read, creating ~12.79 KB marginal pack cost per version.

Removing `baseline_advanced_at` timestamp and moving `last_get_pass` rotation bookkeeping to a separate file reduces marginal packed cost to ≤3.2 KB per version (≤25% of baseline) while preserving reconciler state durability on ephemeral runners.

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/fast-import with operator-controlled quiescence, bundle backup, and fail-closed epoch guards reclaims ~1.05 GiB while preserving all 49,888 commits, 2,661 merges, and byte-identical HEAD tree.

Committed-format changes (deleting `baseline_advanced_at`, moving `last_get_pass`, normalizing baseline text, narrowing `prev_snapshot.json` to keys) use mixed-version read seams and self-healing to ensure reversibility without fixed-delay gates.

Post-publication rollback requires explicit writer quiescence, bundle verification, ref restoration with epoch mismatch fail-closed enforcement at both union sites, and resetting all writer clones before re-enabling.

Two consecutive unchanged reconciler passes must produce byte-identical `bindings.json` with no new commits, and fresh post-rewrite clone size must be ≤150 MiB with corpus mutation deltas demonstrating zero non-empty Jira payload effects.
